book.spectrum.guidebook.cloaking.name: Cloaking
book.spectrum.guidebook.cloaking.page0.t:
A more powerful effect than invisibility, at the cost of not affecting other players.\
No matter the distance, and regardless of how conspicuous your armor is, hostile mobs [#](bb00bb)cannot detect your presence[#]().
book.spectrum.guidebook.cloaking.page1.t: However, using it against bosses is probably not a wise idea...
book.spectrum.guidebook.hostile_approxim: Dealing with various monsters is always troublesome. Time to make a device so you don’t have to worry about them as much anymore.
Anything that looks like a [#](449900)stick[#]() should work...
Anything that looks like a [#](449900)ball[#]() should work...
Armor made of glass that offers almost no protection. You’re not even sure why you would craft it... unless you have a way to override its appearance?

Helmets and boots require two topaz and two citrine, while chestplates and leggings require three.\
Without some kind of cosmetic armor mod, this is basically useless.
book.spectrum.guidebook.lab_coat.name: Lab Coat
book.spectrum.guidebook.lab_coat.page0.t:
As a chromatic scholar, you really should have one of these. After all, responsible researchers ought to look the part.\
Note that the [#](449900)black coat[#]() can only be obtained in survival with [#](bb00bb) Rose’s Thorntilities [#]().
book.spectrum.guidebook.lab_coat.page1.t: It doesn’t offer much protection, but at least it looks more professional.
book.spectrum.guidebook.lab_coat.page3.t: It turns out that real [#](bb00bb)void[#]() doesn’t really go well with a lab coat...
book.spectrum.guidebook.lab_coat.page4.t:
Click the button below to unlock the “furry variant” lab coat. Its tail section is lifted to accommodate player models with tails (e.g., via Ears, Figura, and similar mods).\
Simply place any lab coat into the Rainbow Pedestal to convert between standard and furry variants.
book.spectrum.guidebook.liquid_gems.name: Liquid Gems
book.spectrum.guidebook.pigment_extracto:
While you’re still wondering why [#](bb00bb)brown[#]() is so hard to obtain, you might as well start automating those saplings.\
The [#](449900)Pigment Extractor[#]() slowly produces pigments based on the colored saplings you insert (and may occasionally drop extra saplings!).
Using [#](449900)plant essence[#]() or [#](449900)bone meal[#]() speeds up the process, with plant essence being more efficient.
book.spectrum.guidebook.printer.name: Printer
book.spectrum.guidebook.printer.page0.te:
Dyeing items has always had limitations—the colors you can use depend on available dyes and how many can fit into a crafting grid at once.\
Now that you’ve mastered all elemental ink colors, why not use them directly to color items?
book.spectrum.guidebook.printer.page1.te: Each “print” consumes [#](449900)100 white ink[#](), plus the amount of other ink colors you specify.
